thread:
anya (Docs): Quick sync — I'm doing a microcopy sweep across error labels, param naming, and product nouns. Want to lock decisions so docs PR #3421 doesn't get blocked. TL;DR proposals below, please react or reply quickly.

morgan (Product): +1 to moving fast. What are the concrete changes?

anya (Docs): Proposed rules: 1) HTTP query/path params = param-case (kebab-case) in our REST examples. 2) Client SDK examples use camelCase for object keys and method names. 3) Product names: use 'Redwood API', 'Redwood Dedicated', 'Redwood Private' (Title Case, no extra dashes). 4) Avoid the word 'inference' in user-facing docs; prefer 'serving' or 'model serving' when talking about runtime.

rahul (Eng): For internal infra docs I'd still use 'inference' — but fine to surface 'serving' to customers. On telemetry keys: can we stick to snake_case? our logs and metrics are snake_case.

kai (SDK): SDK team requests camelCase everywhere in the client libs. We can add a short mapping section: REST param-case <-> SDK camelCase. Example: 
```
GET /v1/engines?max-tokens=512 -> JS client: client.create({ maxTokens: 512 })
```
That helps avoid confusion.

anya (Docs): Good idea. I'll add a mapping table to docs/style/naming.md and link it in the PR. Can someone from SDK/Eng add a small snippet for the Python and Go idioms?

kai (SDK): I'll do JS + Python snippet today. Python will use snake_case by convention: `max_tokens`. We'll show both.

morgan (Product): One more: microcopy in error messages. Proposal: keep errors short + actionable. Use title case for labels (e.g., "Request Too Large"); use sentence case for error descriptions.

rahul (Eng): Agree. Also add a note to not leak internal error codes in public messages. Use an internal-only field for the code.

anya (Docs): I'll update docs/style/voice.md with those rules and add two examples (bad -> good). Example: 
```
Bad: "ERR_502_TIMEOUT: kernel oom, retry?"
Good: "Request timed out. Try reducing maxTokens or retry later."
```

doc-bot: Reminder: PR #3421 currently has label `needs-review`.

anya (Docs): Action items: 
- @kai add JS + Python snippet (due EOD)
- @rahul confirm internal vs public error fields (due tomorrow)
- @morgan quick sign-off on product naming (thumbs or :+1:)
- I'll push naming.md and voice.md updates and link in PR #3421

morgan (Product): 👍 on product naming.

rahul (Eng): I'll confirm error fields by EOD tomorrow.

kai (SDK): Snippets posted in PR comments: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3421#issuecomment-1234567890

anya (Docs): thanks — I'll rebase the PR after the snippets land. If anyone sees awkward phrasing in the examples, drop an inline comment on the PR rather than here.

morgan (Product): Maybe add a one-line explainer in the top of naming.md: "Why we choose different casings: interoperability vs idiomatic client usage."

anya (Docs): done — added that sentence in the draft. OK to merge once CI and SDK snippets are in. :sparkles:
